autoStartSceneEnabled.title: Start Raid Scout on an ending scene
autoStartSceneEnabled.description: While Twitch is live, entering the exact OBS scene below starts one search per stream. Repeated Studio Mode scene events are ignored.

autoStartSceneName.title: OBS ending scene name
autoStartSceneName.description: Enter the scene name exactly as it appears in OBS, including emoji or folder symbols.

sourceOrder.title: Discovery request order
sourceOrder.description: Controls which Twitch lists are fetched first. Raid Scout combines every returned eligible channel and always selects the one with the fewest viewers.

preferredChannels.title: Permanent preferred Twitch channels
preferredChannels.description: Your creator-managed list is kept between streams. One login per line or comma-separated.

viewerSuggestionRewardId.title: Twitch suggestion reward ID
viewerSuggestionRewardId.description: Create a Streamer.bot-owned Twitch reward that requires text input, then paste its stable reward ID here.

kickViewerSuggestionRewardId.title: Kick suggestion reward ID
kickViewerSuggestionRewardId.description: Paste the stable Kick reward ID. Kick redemptions are accepted immediately because Streamer.bot does not currently expose Kick reward fulfill or refund methods.

viewerSuggestionCommand.title: YouTube and TikTok suggestion command
viewerSuggestionCommand.description: Use this command with a channel login, for example !raidsuggest creatorname.

oneViewerSuggestionPerStream.title: Allow one suggestion per viewer each stream

announceViewerSuggestions.title: Confirm accepted or rejected suggestions in Twitch chat

viewerSuggestionRejectedMessage.title: Rejected suggestion message
viewerSuggestionRejectedMessage.description: Tokens: {viewer}, {channel}. Keep this generic so blocked-channel rules remain private.
viewerSuggestionRejectedMessage.default: {viewer}, that raid suggestion could not be added.

maximumFollowedPages.title: Maximum followed-stream pages
maximumFollowedPages.description: Each page is one Twitch request. Two is recommended.

allowViewerRangeFallback.title: Use the closest safe match when the viewer ceiling is empty
allowViewerRangeFallback.description: If no otherwise-safe channel is at or below the maximum, Raid Scout may select the closest channel up to twice the configured maximum or 25 viewers above it. Language, channel, category, tag, self, and repeat protections remain enforced.

currentAudienceEstimate.title: Fallback current audience estimate
currentAudienceEstimate.description: Zero uses the broadcaster's live viewer count returned by Twitch.

preferSimilarSize.title: Legacy similar-size preference
preferSimilarSize.description: Retained for configuration compatibility. Raid Scout now always selects the eligible channel with the fewest viewers across every enabled source.

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred Twitch language code
preferredLanguage.description: Examples: en, es, fr. Leave empty for any language.

excludedCategories.title: Excluded categories
excludedCategories.description: Case-insensitive partial matches, one per line.

excludedTags.title: Excluded tags
excludedTags.description: Case-insensitive partial matches, one per line.

recentRaidStreams.title: Do not repeat a destination for this many streams

announceConfirmedRaid.title: Announce only after Twitch accepts the raid

announceNoCandidate.title: Post a no-candidate message in Twitch chat
announceNoCandidate.description: Disabled by default to keep search progress private.

noCandidateMessage.title: No-candidate message
noCandidateMessage.default: Raid Scout could not find a safe live destination with the current filters.

showSearchProgress.title: Show each search phase on the Raid Scout overlay
showSearchProgress.description: Shows preferred, followed, and same-category checks as private overlay progress. It does not post those steps to chat.

showSuggestionCard.title: Show suggestions in the Raid Scout browser card
showSuggestionCard.description: Enabled so a private OBS/Meld/browser dock can show what Confirm will raid. Disable this if the same URL is placed on-stream and you want suggestions hidden from viewers.

showConfirmedCard.title: Show the confirmed Next Stop card

previewClipBeforeRaid.title: Play one random clip before starting the confirmed raid
previewClipBeforeRaid.description: After Confirm, Raid Scout requests a bounded clip list, plays the selected clip through completion, then starts the raid. The ending ad can run in parallel from the moment Suggest begins.

pauseOtherVideoOverlays.title: Pause other THSV video overlays during the raid preview
pauseOtherVideoOverlays.description: Recommended. Confirming a raid temporarily fades and pauses Random Clip Player or another coordinated THSV video overlay so the two clips cannot overlap.

clipLookupCount.title: Clips considered for random selection
clipLookupCount.description: Streamer.bot requests this many public clips for the selected channel. One is chosen locally at random.

clipPreviewMuted.title: Mute the raid clip preview
clipPreviewMuted.description: Keep enabled when browser-source autoplay blocks audio. OBS browser sources normally support unmuted playback.

endBroadcastAfterRaid.title: End the broadcast after the raid attempt
endBroadcastAfterRaid.description: Disabled by default. In after-ad mode, Suggest starts or adopts the ad, confirmation and clip playback continue during it, and the approved stop action runs after the genuine ad timer even if Twitch rejects or cannot confirm the raid.

endBroadcastActionId.title: Stop Streaming action
endBroadcastActionId.description: OBS/Aitum: choose the included Stop All OBS Streaming Outputs action. Meld or Streamlabs: choose an action containing that provider's native Stop Streaming sub-action. Approve the same action in Raid Scout's action grants.

endBroadcastTiming.title: When to end the broadcast
endBroadcastTiming.description: After-ad asks Twitch to start the ending ad, then waits for a genuine Twitch Ad Run event and uses Twitch's reported duration. Countdown preserves the older fixed-delay behavior.

endBroadcastDelaySeconds.title: Cancelable end-stream countdown (seconds)
endBroadcastDelaySeconds.description: Raid Scout Cancel aborts automatic ending only before the Stop Streaming action is sent.

endBroadcastAdDurationSeconds.title: Ending Twitch ad length
endBroadcastAdDurationSeconds.description: The duration Raid Scout asks Twitch to run. Twitch's genuine Ad Run event remains the authoritative timer.

endBroadcastAdWaitSeconds.title: Maximum wait for Twitch to confirm the ad (seconds)
endBroadcastAdWaitSeconds.description: After the raid attempt and ending-ad request, wait this long for a genuine Twitch Ad Run signal. If none arrives, leave the broadcast running because there is no trustworthy ad timer.

endBroadcastAdEndBufferSeconds.title: Extra buffer after the ad (seconds)
endBroadcastAdEndBufferSeconds.description: Small safety buffer added after Twitch's reported ad duration before Stop Streaming runs.

endBroadcastAcknowledged.title: I understand this can end my live broadcast
endBroadcastAcknowledged.description: Required in addition to enabling the feature. Raid Scout never retries a failed or unconfirmed stop command.
